# NavRail

The main navigation.

`LL.NavRail` · Shell

## Use

```jsx
<LL.NavRail sections={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.NavRail" sections="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Hover fades the surface-raised wash in over duration-fast; the active item, its bar and its wash move at once — the current location never animates. As GameShell's drawer under 60rem it slides in over duration-base and out over duration-fast.

### NavItem

locked (Standards · States): stays in the Tab order (aria-disabled), says "Locked" where the badge goes, shows `reason` — how it unlocks — in the reason tip beside it, and a click or Enter shows the reason instead of navigating.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` |  |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `description` | `string` | A short line under the title ("Stats, vitals, loadout"), so a destination is never known by its icon alone (D-104). Hidden in compact. |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `href` | `string` |  |
| `badge` | `React.ReactNode` | A count: unread, ready. |
| `badgeLabel` | `string` | What screen readers hear for the badge or the diamond: "3 new items". |
| `locked` | `boolean` |  |
| `reason` | `string` |  |
| `ready` | `boolean \| string` | Something waiting with nothing to count: the attention diamond at the item's end. true, or the words ("Quest ready"). A count `badge` comes first, and Locked before both (Standards · State combinations). |
